description: Pair the two unit legs of square C with the two unit legs of triangle F in the same L orientation. Misusing the square area1 as the area of the right-triangular base in the removed-corner tetrahedron gives removed volume1/3 rather than1/6, hence2/3. All original triangles and edges remain, with no false length symbol.
